name: Maria Campanella
original_name: マリーア・カンパネッラ
source:
From year: 1869

A maid who works in the mansion.

She's affable and frank, cheerful and lackadaisical—but she never slacks on the job.

Maria is the only one in the mansion willing to get involved with Jacopo's neglected, mistreated wife, with whom she's begun to form a friendship. She's also the only person who doesn't seem to fear Jacopo, though no one's quite sure why.

"If you're having a good time, what does it matter what's between your legs?"

[From the [url=http://mangagamer.org/fatamorgana/]English official site[/url]]

[spoiler]In [url=/v18397]Fata morgana no Yakata -Another Episodes-[/url]:

A caring, supportive young woman.

She can come off as somewhat detached and impassive, but once you’ve won Maria’s trust, she treats you like family.

And if you betray that trust, you’ll never get it back.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1053/]MangaGamer[/url]][/spoiler]
